detailed_descriptions_html.en:
【Cozy Greenhouse Organization Simulator】

You bought an abandoned greenhouse.

Sort and arrange 2597 flowers and plants, put everything in its proper place, and turn the neglected greenhouse into the garden of your dreams.

【Bring the Greenhouse Back to Life】

  • Sort & Organize: From colorful flowers to all kinds of plants, use their names, colors, species, and other clues to figure out where each one belongs.

  • A Greenhouse Full of Plants: What looks overwhelming at first slowly starts to come together. Organize every flower and plant, fill the empty spaces, and watch the greenhouse take shape piece by piece.

【Make the Greenhouse Yours】

  • Clean Up the Mess: The greenhouse has seen better days. Pick up scattered pots and plants, sort everything out, and slowly turn the neglected space into a cozy, organized greenhouse.

  • Organize Your Way: Decide how you want to tackle the greenhouse. Find the route and rhythm that work best for you as you carry, sort, and arrange your plants.

  • Compete for the Top Spot: Found the fastest way to organize everything? Compare your best time with other players and climb the online leaderboard.

【Helpful Skills】

As you progress, you’ll unlock skills that make organizing the greenhouse easier and faster.

  • Gather: Quickly bring matching flowers or plants directly to you, saving you the trouble of searching around the greenhouse.

  • Spotlight: Highlights matching plants, making them much easier to find among all the pots and flowers.

  • Auto-Place: Automatically places the plants you’re carrying into their correct spots, helping you organize the greenhouse even faster.
